description: Test case with incorrect hunk offsets that can break the diff apply mechanism NOTE (2026-11-02): the original diff wrapped load_data's if/elif chain in try: but re-indented only the first two branch headers, so no placement could yield valid Python and the language validator rolled every apply back. Hunks 1-2 are merged and fully re-indented; hunks 3-4 (and their +-side offsets) are unchanged, which is where the placement challenge lives.
